tool_args.rationale: The bridge and flux-conservation signatures suggest coupled transfer dynamics, but the one-dimensional pilot leaves genuine identifiability ambiguity. An open-branch discriminating probe can distinguish the mechanism before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a saturating response to the pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five observations share the same state, gradient, and horizon, so they cannot identify the proposed two-layer dynamics or their dependence on other inputs.
The open-branch probe is cheaper and directly targets the unresolved mechanism.
It is irrelevant to discriminating the mechanism.
